scenes.name: Electrónica de los setenta
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: La primera dosis de electrónica extrema para los chicos de Sheffield fue la banda sonora de Walter Carlos para La naranja mecánica; antes solo había atisbos en el Moog de Keith Emerson y los chorros de ruido de Eno en Roxy Music. Detrás asoman la música concreta, Morton Subotnick y los paisajes de Tangerine Dream.

podcast.title: Death (March 10, 2016)
podcast.body: Keith Emerson, keyboardist for Emerson, Lake & Palmer, died by suicide on March 10, 2016. "March 10th, Keith Emerson, keyboardist for Emerson, like in Palmer, suicide."

podcast.title: Death in 2016
podcast.body: Keith Emerson of Emerson, Lake & Palmer died in 2016, joining a lengthy list of significant musicians whose deaths defined that year as one of profound loss for music fans. "David Bowie, Prince, Glen Fry of the Eagles, two members of the Jefferson Airplane, Matt Roberts of Three Doors Down, George Michael, Beatles producer George Martin, Keith Emerson and Greg Lake of Emerson, like in Palmer, Maurice White of Earth Wind and Fire and dozens more."

podcast.body: Keith Emerson is identified as a member of Emerson, Lake & Palmer, a prominent progressive rock supergroup. His work with the band establishes him as a key figure in piano-driven music. "Keith Emerson of Emerson, Lincoln Palmer."
